steps.en: Clone the repo, install requirements, and put a downloaded checkpoint under checkpoints/
steps.zh: 克隆仓库、装依赖，把下载的 checkpoint 放进 checkpoints/

steps.en: Pick a model size and load its weights (Small is the only Apache-2.0 one)
steps.zh: 选模型尺寸并加载权重（只有 Small 是 Apache-2.0）

steps.en: Read an image with OpenCV and hand it to the model
steps.zh: 用 OpenCV 读一张图，交给模型

steps.en: Resizes the image to a 518-pixel input and runs the DINOv2 encoder plus DPT head
steps.zh: 把图缩放到 518 像素输入，跑 DINOv2 编码器和 DPT 头

component.zh: DINOv2 编码器 + DPT 头

steps.en: Scales the prediction back to your image size and returns an HxW NumPy depth map
steps.zh: 把预测缩放回原图尺寸，返回 HxW 的 NumPy 深度图

value.en: A per-pixel depth map from one ordinary photo — no stereo rig, no LiDAR, no training
value.zh: 一张普通照片就能得到逐像素深度图，不用双目、LiDAR，也不用训练

sources: https://github.com/DepthAnything/Depth-Anything-V2#usage (git clone, pip install -r requirements.txt, checkpoints directory, encoder = 'vitl' # or 'vits', 'vitb', 'vitg', depth = model.infer_image(raw_img) # HxW raw depth map in numpy)
https://github.com/DepthAnything/Depth-Anything-V2/blob/main/depth_anything_v2/dpt.py (infer_image: input_size=518, DPT head, F.interpolate back to (h, w))
